# runpod_endpoint_build (Data Source)

A single container build of a Serverless endpoint, looked up by endpoint and build identifier.

**If you are an AI agent:** set up through https://agents.runpod.io first, then follow
[Using the provider from an AI agent](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/runpod/runpod/latest/docs/guides/agent-setup) before you plan or apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "runpod_endpoint_build" "latest" {
  endpoint_id = "ep_abc123"
  id          = "build_abc"
}

output "built_image" {
  description = "Image the build produced; null until it completes."
  value       = data.runpod_endpoint_build.latest.image_name
}

output "build_failure" {
  description = "Failure detail; null unless the build failed."
  value       = data.runpod_endpoint_build.latest.error
}
```

Complete, runnable configurations that use this data source live in the
[use-case modules](https://github.com/runpod/terraform-provider-runpod/tree/main/v2/modules);
the Guides section documents each one.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `endpoint_id` (String) Serverless endpoint identifier the build belongs to.
- `id` (String) Build identifier.

### Read-Only

- `branch` (String) Git branch the build came from.
- `commit_date` (String) Commit timestamp in RFC 3339 format.
- `commit_hash` (String) Git commit the build came from.
- `commit_message` (String) Commit message of the built commit.
- `completed_at` (String) Build finish timestamp in RFC 3339 format; null while it is still running.
- `error` (String) Failure detail; null unless the build failed.
- `image_name` (String) Image the build produced; null until it completes.
- `started_at` (String) Build start timestamp in RFC 3339 format.
- `status` (String) Build state: PENDING, BUILDING, UPLOADING, TESTING, COMPLETED, FAILED, TEST_FAILED, or CANCELLED.
